# Felix Phan, PORTFOLIO

> Felix Phan (legal name Nguyễn Phan Thục Hương, written without diacritics as Nguyen Phan Thuc Huong; pronouns they/them) is a creative strategist and storyteller based in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi, Vietnam. Felix moves ideas from insight to story to delivery: consumer research, scriptwriting, event production and project management. This is Felix Phan's official portfolio.

## Key facts

- Professional name: Felix Phan
- Legal name: Nguyễn Phan Thục Hương, written Nguyen Phan Thuc Huong without diacritics (certificates are issued under this spelling)
- Pronouns: they/them
- Role: Creative Strategist & Storyteller
- Education: Bachelor of Professional Communication, RMIT University; Bachelor of Business Administration in English, National Economics University. Both 2022 to April 2027, completed simultaneously; all coursework complete.
- Base: Ho Chi Minh City & Hanoi, Vietnam
- Availability: full-time roles, available now
- Email: felixphan.contact@gmail.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/felixphan/
